# Merge keys and aliases are expanded before validation.
yamlschema -schema schema.json ok.yaml
! yamlschema -schema schema.json bad.yaml
stdout '^bad.yaml:5:'

-- schema.json --
{"type":"object","additionalProperties":{"type":"object","required":["image","replicas"],"properties":{"replicas":{"type":"integer"}}}}
-- ok.yaml --
base: &base {image: app, replicas: 1}
web:
  <<: *base
  replicas: 3
-- bad.yaml --
base: &base {image: app, replicas: 1}
web:
  <<: *base
worker:
  replicas: two
